newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kellwood started with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kellwood started with buy.

text.p: Dillon Read said it started coverage of Kellwood Co on Friday with a buy rating.
-- Analyst Allison Malkin said in a report that the company should be able to grow sales though existing retail accounts and to selectively acquire companies.
-- estimates Q1 1998 earnings at $0.29 a share, Q2 at $0.72, Q3 $0.15 and Q4 $0.79.
-- said operating income has risen at compound annual growth rate of about 22 percent since Kellwood implemented "Vision 2000" plan in the second half of fiscal 1995.
-- "We expect the operating margin to expand to 8.5 percent in fiscal 2000 versus 6.6 percent in fiscal 1997," she said in a research report.
-- set 12-month price target at $40, based on stock trading at 17 times fiscal 1999 estimates of $2.40.
-- Kellwood shares closed at 30-1/2 on Thursday on the NYSE.
